# Matthew Anderson

> Software Engineer at Deere & Company. Side projects in health tech, home automation and data tools. This site is the portfolio: a write-up of each project, a few technical posts, and a work history.

Every page on this site is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`.

Work history:

- Software Engineer, Deere & Company, 2021 to present
- Business Analyst, Deere & Company, 2013 to 2021
- IT Early Development Program, Deere & Company, 2009 to 2013

Education:

- B.A. Information Systems, St. Ambrose University, 2009
- Graduate-level coursework, Computer Science, St. Ambrose University, 2009 to 2012
- Software Engineering Immersive, General Assembly, 2021

## Projects

- [VitalSense](https://andernet.dev/projects/health/): Apple Health insights, fall-risk scoring and caregiver alerts: a native iOS app feeding a web dashboard on Cloudflare Workers.
- [HomeHub](https://andernet.dev/projects/homehub/): An iOS-inspired smart home dashboard: Philips Hue control, live Arlo camera streaming, scenes and automations. A React 19 PWA on Cloudflare.
- [Andernator](https://andernet.dev/projects/guess/): An Akinator-style guessing game that shows its reasoning: Bayesian scoring over 53,000+ characters, with every question explained.
- [andernet.dev — This Portfolio](https://andernet.dev/projects/and3rn3t/): The site you're on: plain ES modules on GitHub Pages, pages pre-rendered from JSON, a WebAssembly particle hero, and a Cloudflare Worker for the live parts.
- [Minecraft Server for Raspberry Pi 5](https://andernet.dev/projects/minecraft/): A Minecraft server stack for the Raspberry Pi 5: Docker deployment, automated and offsite backups, a Flask REST API and a React admin panel.
- [Weather for iOS 26](https://andernet.dev/projects/weather-app/): A SwiftUI weather app for iOS 26 with Liquid Glass design, widgets and Live Activities, plus an Android companion in Jetpack Compose.
- [Fast Lane](https://andernet.dev/projects/fastlane/): A single-player life-sim board game where the rat race is the board: 60 hours a week to reach four life goals before your rival does.
- [Apple Music DJ](https://andernet.dev/projects/apple-music-dj/): An AI Apple Music curator: it profiles your real listening history and builds playlists in your library. An Agent Skill for Claude Code and OpenClaw.
- [NetInsight](https://andernet.dev/projects/net-traffic/): A home network traffic dashboard: packet capture on a Raspberry Pi 5, with the dashboard served from Cloudflare Pages.
- [Weather (web)](https://andernet.dev/projects/weather/): A React and TypeScript weather web app with an iOS-style interface, Capacitor for mobile, deployed on Cloudflare.
- [Couple Connect](https://andernet.dev/projects/couple-connect/): A relationship app for couples: shared daily challenges, progress tracking and rewards. React 19 on Cloudflare Pages.
- [UniFi Network API Client](https://andernet.dev/projects/network/): A Python client for the UniFi Network controller API, with automated data collection, analytics and alerting.
- [HuggingFace Playground](https://andernet.dev/projects/huggingface/): Browse Hugging Face datasets and models, compare them, and try the Inference API, in one interface.
- [The Hack: Ghost Protocol](https://andernet.dev/projects/hack/): A horror-themed hacking simulator and capture-the-flag game in Rust, with 26+ challenges for beginners and up.
- [Data Science Workspace](https://andernet.dev/projects/dbt/): A data science workspace: Python analysis, dbt transformations and Jupyter notebooks.
- [CATastrophe](https://andernet.dev/projects/catastrophe/): CATastrophe: A Mischief Simulator. A 3D Unreal Engine 5 game where you play a cat causing havoc in a house without getting caught.
- [Denon AVR Remote](https://andernet.dev/projects/remote/): A SwiftUI remote for Denon AV receivers, built to iOS 26 design guidelines: Liquid Glass, multi-zone control and Dynamic Island now-playing.

## Writing

- [Making a Portfolio Agent-Ready: llms.txt, MCP and WebMCP](https://andernet.dev/posts/making-a-portfolio-agent-ready/): What I changed so AI assistants can read and query this site: a generated llms.txt, a clear crawl policy, a read-only MCP server on the Worker, in-page tools, and the traps along the way. (2026-11-13)
- [How This Site Works: Vanilla JS, WebAssembly, and a Cloudflare Worker](https://andernet.dev/posts/how-this-site-works/): A tour of the architecture behind this portfolio: framework-free ES modules, pages pre-rendered from JSON, a WASM particle hero, a token-based design system, and a Cloudflare Worker for the live parts. (2026-07-12)
- [On-Device Gait Analysis with iPhone LiDAR and HealthKit](https://andernet.dev/posts/lidar-gait-analysis-iphone/): How I used the iPhone's LiDAR depth sensor and Apple HealthKit to detect walking irregularities without any wearable hardware — all processed on-device with no cloud intermediary. (2026-05-12)
- [Building a Local-First IoT Dashboard Without the Cloud](https://andernet.dev/posts/local-first-iot-dashboard/): Why I stopped routing smart home data through vendor clouds and what I built instead — a local-first dashboard that works even when the internet is down. (2026-04-03)
